kjv: what [is] the fellowship of the mystery … who created all things by Jesus Christ
mine: what is the plan of the mystery … Who created all things
note: TR "koinonia" (fellowship) against "oikonomia" (plan, administration; all early manuscripts), and adds "dia Iesou Christou".

kjv: unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ
note: TR adds "tou kyriou hemon Iesou Christou"; absent from P46, Sinaiticus*, A, B, C. Without it the wordplay "patera … patria" (Father … every family) in 3:15 stands out.

kjv: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named
mine: from Whom every family in heaven and on earth is named
note: pasa patria without the article is "every family/clan", each deriving its name from the Father; "the whole family" makes it one family, the church.
